say:1:1013608001:1.text: As we agreed, ask anything and I will answer.
say:1:1013608001:1.source_cn: 就如我们战前约定的那样，你们想知道什么，就问吧。
say:1:1013608001:1.male: As we agreed, ask anything and I will answer.
say:1:1013608001:1.female: As we agreed, ask anything and I will answer.

say:2:1013608002:1.text: But first, tell me your name.
say:2:1013608002:1.source_cn: 不过在此之前，请告诉我你的名字。
say:2:1013608002:1.male: But first, tell me your name.
say:2:1013608002:1.female: But first, tell me your name.

choice_prompt:3:1013608002.text: But first, tell me your name.
choice_prompt:3:1013608002.source_cn: 不过在此之前，请告诉我你的名字。
choice_prompt:3:1013608002.male: But first, tell me your name.
choice_prompt:3:1013608002.female: But first, tell me your name.

say:6:1013608005:2.text: So, Shakir, please answer the magister's questions sincerely!
say:6:1013608005:2.source_cn: 那么，沙奎尔先生，就请认真回答主人的问题！
say:6:1013608005:2.male: So, Shakir, please answer the magister's questions sincerely!
say:6:1013608005:2.female: So, Shakir, please answer the magister's questions sincerely!

say:7:1013608006:0.source_cn: 我不会违背许下的诺言。

choice_prompt:9:1013608006.source_cn: 我不会违背许下的诺言。

say:10:1013608007:1.text: They hired me, but this isn't their turf. This place is mine. It was claimed by these claws of mine!
say:10:1013608007:1.source_cn: 黑金商会雇佣了我，但这里可不是他们的地盘。这里属于我！...
say:10:1013608007:1.male: They hired me, but this isn't their turf. This place is mine. It was claimed by these claws of mine!
say:10:1013608007:1.female: They hired me, but this isn't their turf. This place is mine. It was claimed by these claws of mine!

say:11:1013608010:0.text: Seen my crew? The Syndicate hired them, but not a single one of them can match me.
say:11:1013608010:0.source_cn: 你见过我手下那群弱小的人吗？他们也是被黑金雇佣的人，但...
say:11:1013608010:0.male: Seen my crew? The Syndicate hired them, but not a single one of them can match me.
say:11:1013608010:0.female: Seen my crew? The Syndicate hired them, but not a single one of them can match me.

say:12:1013608011:0.text: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
say:12:1013608011:0.source_cn: 所以他们只能去干一些黑金商会安排的活，影响武技的磨练。
say:12:1013608011:0.male: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
say:12:1013608011:0.female: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.

choice_prompt:13:1013608011.text: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
choice_prompt:13:1013608011.source_cn: 所以他们只能去干一些黑金商会安排的活，影响武技的磨练。
choice_prompt:13:1013608011.male: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.
choice_prompt:13:1013608011.female: So they just do general mundane tasks assigned by the Syndicate.

say:14:1013608012:1.text: I came from the Ashen Wastes to train and grow stronger. Before I met you, the golems were my best sparring partners.
say:14:1013608012:1.source_cn: 我从荒角沙漠而来，只为磨炼武技，增强力量。在你之前，魔...
say:14:1013608012:1.male: I came from the Ashen Wastes to train and grow stronger. Before I met you, the golems were my best sparring partners.
say:14:1013608012:1.female: I came from the Ashen Wastes to train and grow stronger. Before I met you, the golems were my best sparring partners.

say:15:1013608013:1.text: Though they often got damaged, there were always more around.
say:15:1013608013:1.source_cn: 虽然总会损坏，但每次都有新的替补。
say:15:1013608013:1.male: Though they often got damaged, there were always more around.
say:15:1013608013:1.female: Though they often got damaged, there were always more around.

say:17:1013608015:0.text: It sounds like all of this is part of the conspiracy by the Adamant Syndicate, but their real goal is still a mystery.
say:17:1013608015:0.source_cn: 听起来，这一切还是黑金商会阴谋的一环，但他们的目的我们...
say:17:1013608015:0.male: It sounds like all of this is part of the conspiracy by the Adamant Syndicate, but their real goal is still a mystery.
say:17:1013608015:0.female: It sounds like all of this is part of the conspiracy by the Adamant Syndicate, but their real goal is still a mystery.

say:18:1013608016:2.text: Shakir, can we speak to your crew?
say:18:1013608016:2.source_cn: 沙奎尔先生，我们能否向你的手下询问？

say:19:1013608017:0.text: Sure, but I should warn you if you want to fight them, they're pretty weak.
say:19:1013608017:0.source_cn: 可以，但他们太弱小了，不经打。

say:21:1013608018:2.text: ... I promise you, we only want to ask them questions.

say:22:1013608019:2.text: Alright. Hey, you lot! Over here!
say:22:1013608019:2.source_cn: 这样吗？喂，你们几个！就是你们几个，过来！

say:24:1013608020:3.source_cn: 啊……老大，你是在叫我们吗？

say:25:1013608021:0.text: Yeah, these folks are opponents I respect. You'd better answer their questions truthfully!
say:25:1013608021:0.source_cn: 没错，这些人是我尊重的对手，他们有话要问你们，老实回答！

say:26:1013608022:0.text: And as for me, let me clean up a bit. My claws and fur got dirty during the battle...
say:26:1013608022:0.source_cn: 至于我，容我先清理一下，战斗中弄脏的爪子和皮毛……

say:28:1013608014:1.text: Boring work. Digging, looting, transporting things around.
say:28:1013608014:1.source_cn: 很无聊的活计，挖掘、盗宝、组装还有运输。
say:28:1013608014:1.male: Boring work. Digging, looting, transporting things around.
say:28:1013608014:1.female: Boring work. Digging, looting, transporting things around.

choice:13:1:2.text: What tasks do they give you?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 黑金商会安排什么样的活？
choice:13:1:2.male: What tasks do they give you?
choice:13:1:2.female: What tasks do they give you?

say:29:1013608008:0.text: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
say:29:1013608008:0.source_cn: 这里是我的营地！我用这双利爪打下来的！
say:29:1013608008:0.male: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
say:29:1013608008:0.female: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!

choice_prompt:30:1013608008.text: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
choice_prompt:30:1013608008.source_cn: 这里是我的营地！我用这双利爪打下来的！
choice_prompt:30:1013608008.male: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!
choice_prompt:30:1013608008.female: This is my camp! I claimed it with these claws of mine!

say:31:1013608009:0.text: They hired me to manage these folks.
say:31:1013608009:0.source_cn: 黑金商会雇了我，让我安排人干一些事情。
say:31:1013608009:0.male: They hired me to manage these folks.
say:31:1013608009:0.female: They hired me to manage these folks.

choice:30:0:1.text: How do you know the Syndicate?
choice:30:0:1.male: How do you know the Syndicate?
choice:30:0:1.female: How do you know the Syndicate?

say:32:1013608004:0.text: Feels like I've heard that name before. Fate has brought us together!
say:32:1013608004:0.source_cn: 总觉得在哪里听过，这一定是命运对我们相遇的暗示！
say:32:1013608004:0.male: Feels like I've heard that name before. Fate has brought us together!
say:32:1013608004:0.female: Feels like I've heard that name before. Fate has brought us together!
